description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including its data types and SQL, and use Managed Identity for database authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, BLOB data types, and plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL with Managed Identity is the target managed relational database and authentication approach on Azure.
tasks.requirements: Replace ojdbc8 Oracle JDBC driver dependency with PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle BLOB columns used to store photo binary data to PostgreSQL bytea, and convert Oracle-specific repository SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Update application.properties and application-docker.properties datasource URLs for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
